title: 49ers’ Dre Greenlaw slapped with hefty fine for punching Falcons’ Drake London

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers’ Dre Greenlaw slapped with hefty fine for punching Falcons’ Drake London
sources.description: San Francisco 49ers LB Dre Greenlaw was fined $12,537 by the NFL for striking Atlanta Falcons receiver Drake London in the helmet.
